test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: For what purpose are pins and clips used in engineering drawings?

options.text: To support the drawing paper/tracing paper for making drawings
To fasten the drawing sheet on to the drawing board firmly so that it does not shake
To transfer dimensions and dividing lines into a number of equal parts
To draw horizontal lines, parallel lines and to guide/hold the set squares

solution:
The correct answer is __To fasten the drawing sheet on to the drawing board firmly so that it does not shake.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pins and clips__ are essential tools in engineering drawing.
 
• They are primarily used to secure the drawing sheet firmly onto the drawing board.
 
• This ensures that the sheet does not move or shake while creating precise drawings.
 
• The stability provided by pins and clips helps maintain accuracy in the drawn dimensions and lines.
 
• They are particularly useful when working on large sheets or intricate designs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Protractor:**

 
 
• Used to measure and draw angles in engineering drawings.
 
• Provides accuracy in creating angular measurements.
 
 
 
• **Divider:**
 
 
• A tool used to transfer dimensions and divide lines into equal parts.
 
• It aids in maintaining proportional measurements.
 
 
 
• **Set Squares:**
 
 
• Used to draw straight lines, parallel lines, and perpendicular lines.
 
• Helps in creating accurate geometric shapes.
